```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      message = FALSE)

# Load minimal packages
library(vitae)
library(tibble)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(glue)
library(here)

# Load data from Excel
excel_file <- here("jpbsCVdata", "cv_data_with_education.xlsx")

# Check if file exists
if (!file.exists(excel_file)) {
  stop("Excel file not found at: ", excel_file)
}

# Read Administrative data
admin <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Administrative") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order)

# Read Education data - Fixed column processing
edu <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Education") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", "),
    inst = institution,
    degree = degree,
    startYear = as.character(start_year),
    endYear = as.character(end_year),
    # Safely combine detail columns
    detail = case_when(
      !is.na(detail_1) ~ as.character(detail_1),
      TRUE ~ ""
    )
  )

# Read Certifications - Using correct column names
certifications <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Certifications") %>%
  filter(highlight == TRUE | is.na(highlight)) %>%
  arrange(display_order) %>%
  mutate(
    certBody = cert_body,
    accomplishment = accomplishment,
    year = as.character(year),
    where = if_else(is.na(where), "", where),
    detail = if_else(is.na(detail), "", detail)
  )

# Read minimal Employment data
employment <- read_excel(excel_file, sheet = "Employment") %>%
  arrange(desc(current))

# Process Long-term employment (simplified)
ltWork <- employment %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%  # Just show first 5 for testing
  mutate(
    institution = institution,
    detail = position_title,
    # Parse Month-Year format dates
    startMonth = if_else(!is.na(start_date), 
                        sub("-.*", "", start_date),  # Extract month part
                        ""),
    startYear = if_else(!is.na(start_date), 
                       sub(".*-", "", start_date),  # Extract year part
                       ""),
    endMonth = case_when(
      current == TRUE ~ "Present",
      !is.na(end_date) ~ sub("-.*", "", end_date),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    endYear = case_when(
      current == TRUE ~ "",
      !is.na(end_date) ~ sub(".*-", "", end_date),
      TRUE ~ ""
    ),
    where = paste(location_city, location_state, sep = ", ")
  )
```

# LONG-TERM ACADEMIC APPOINTMENTS

```{r LTEMPLOYMENT}
ltWork %>%
  detailed_entries(
    with = institution,
    why = detail,
    when = glue::glue("{startMonth} {startYear} --> {endMonth} {endYear}", .na = ""),
    where = where
  )
```
